prompts.text: What invitation have you repeatedly postponed?
What changed in your body when you admitted the invitation was still there?
What has been quietly calling that I keep postponing?

blocks.title: I hear you
blocks.instruction: Say the invitation aloud in the plainest words you have. Then say only: "I hear you." Before the day ends, make one visible place for it — a note, folder, blank page, or object. Do not begin the work.
